name: ThirdShotHub SunGuard Hooded Long Sleeve
description: The ThirdShotHub SunGuard Hooded Long Sleeve protects you during long outdoor sessions. The fabric is rated UPF 50+, blocking over 98% of UV rays, and a lightweight hood covers your neck and ears without blocking peripheral vision. Thumbholes keep the sleeves in place over the backs of your hands, and the recycled polyester knit wicks sweat and dries fast.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors and tumble dry low. Skip fabric softener, which reduces wicking.
